create_test_prompts: create test prompts with sampling parameters for offline LLM inference
process_requests: process a list of prompts through the LLMEngine with step-based iteration and output handling
initialize_engine: initialize an LLMEngine instance from command-line arguments using EngineArgs
reset_prefix_cache: reset the LLMEngine prefix cache and optionally reset running requests
run_llm_engine_cli: run the LLMEngine offline inference demo with configurable sampling parameters via CLI
